entity.summary: Netherlands-based centralized crypto-asset trading platform providing account-based execution, custody, euro and USDC markets, staking, bundles, and institutional services under a Dutch MiCAR authorization.
entity.notes: Current first-party material identifies Finst B.V., its Amsterdam registration, and AFM crypto-asset service provider authorization number 41000015. Finst acquired strategic assets from Anycoin Direct and received migrated customers, but the existing Anycoin Direct events already document that transition. BX38 keeps it event-only and does not add a canonical predecessor edge under the frozen A3/A4 lineage contract.

evidence.title: Finst official crypto platform
evidence.notes: Current platform identifies Finst B.V., its Amsterdam registration, active trading products, and Dutch AFM MiCAR authorization number 41000015.

evidence.title: AFM crypto-asset service provider register
evidence.publisher: Dutch Authority for the Financial Markets
evidence.notes: Current AFM register explains that listed CASPs hold an authorization or notification permitting specified crypto-asset services in the Netherlands and provides the authoritative lookup surface for Finst's disclosed authorization.
